title: [Snyk] SNYK-JS-LODASH-15869625 in lodash@4.17.23
description:
## Arbitrary Code Injection

**Severity:** high
**Package:** lodash@4.17.23
**File:** `apps/dashboard/package.json`

**CVSS Score:** 8.6  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 501/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2026-4800](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-4800)

**Fix:** Pin `lodash` to version 4.18.1 or later.

### Details
## Overview
[lodash](https://www.npmjs.com/package/lodash) is a modern JavaScript utility library delivering modularity, performance, & extras.

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Arbitrary Code Injection due the improper validation of `options.imports` key names in `_.template`. An attacker can execute arbitrary code at template compilation time by injecting malicious expressions. If `Object.prototype` has been polluted, inherited properties may also be copied into the imports object and executed.

**Notes:**

1) Version 4.18.0 was intended to fix this vulnerability but it got deprecated due to introducing a breaking [functionality issue](https://github.com/lodash/lodash/issues/6167).

2) This issue is due to the incomplete fix for [CVE-2021-23337](https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-JS-LODASH-1040724).
## Remediation
Upgrade `lodash` to version 4.18.1 or higher.
## References
- [GitHub Advisory](https://github.com/lodash/lodash/security/advisories/GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc)
- [GitHub Commit](https://github.com/lodash/lodash/commit/879aaa93132d78c2f8d20c60279da9f8b21576d6)
- [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/lodash/lodash/issues/6167)
- [OpenJS Security Advisory](https://cna.openjsf.org/security-advisories.html)

comments.text: Still present after updating apps/dashboard lockfile and upgrading to latest published aws-amplify stack (aws-amplify 6.16.3, @aws-amplify/storage 6.13.2). Upstream package line currently pins vulnerable transitive versions (lodash 4.17.23 and fast-xml-parser 5.3.4 in analytics path). Recommend Snyk ignore with expiry/review date while tracking upstream releases.
